optional_sources: read-only Zerion aggregate portfolio API (API key or x402 pay-per-call)

exclusions.fake_execution_adapter: src/scout_portfolio_manager/adapters.py:FakeExecutionAdapter is test-only domain scaffolding for isolated unit tests; never imported by host.py or mcp_server.py, never wired to any tool surface, does not touch funds.
exclusions.live_zerion_key: No Zerion API key or wallet address ships in this repo; the optional adapter activates only when ZERION_API_KEY and ZERION_WALLET_ADDRESS are both set in the installer's own environment.
exclusions.demo_data_source: demo/zerion-portfolio-agent reads only fixtures/portfolio.json; it makes no live Zerion calls and ships no other dataset.

data_boundary: No repository database or hosted retention service; integrating hosts and API providers have separate policies.
release_notes: Early release. See WHAT-BROKE.md and RELEASE-MANIFEST.json.
evidence_boundary: Proves what surfaces and sources are wired into this build, and what was deliberately left out; does not prove those surfaces behave correctly at runtime, or that an excluded item is absent from a fork of this tree.
